title: Investor guide to Bitcoin
summary: Discover Bitcoin's potential as an investment. Learn about its valuation, role in portfolios, debunking myths, and environmental impact. Explore insights with CoinShares.
body_markdown:
### Bitcoin valuation


Bitcoin's limited supply, decentralised nature, and increasing recognition as a store of value make it a potential alternative to traditional alternative investments.


[Discover bitcoin valuation](https://coinshares.com/insights/research-data/bitcoin-valuation-by-savings-adoption/)


### Bitcoin fundamentals


Bitcoin is investable because its exceptional monetary properties and significant potential for future adoption as money far exceed its current usage.


[Explore bitcoin’s case](https://coinshares.com/insights/research-data/the-fundamental-investment-case-for-bitcoin/)


### Bitcoin in a portfolio


Bitcoin could offer significant advantages for portfolio diversification, acting as a non-correlated asset that can improve risk-adjusted returns.


[Read our research](https://coinshares.com/insights/research-data/the-bitcoin-advantage-enhancing-real-world-portfolios/)
